== Version ==
These guides cover '''0.9.5.6''', associated with the Chinese-availability announcement of 12 November 2026; that announcement does not name a version or establish the binary's exact release time. Gameplay rules are unchanged from 0.9.5.5. Other versions may differ. See [[Version 0.9.5.6]] for what changed since 0.9.5.5, and [[Versions]] for every earlier version.
